assistant_welcome: What would you like to do today?
assistant_intro: A little clarity. A next step. Your apps, in one conversation.
assistant_prompt_memory: What do you remember about me?
assistant_placeholder: An idea, a question, something to get done…
assistant_interrupted: Response interrupted · confirmed actions are preserved.
assistant_failed: This response could not be completed.
assistant_footnote: Life AI can make mistakes. Check important changes.
assistant_configuration_needed: Choose a provider and add your API key in settings to get started.
assistant_no_apps: Enable your apps in the library to use them with your assistant.
assistant_delete_description: This conversation will be permanently deleted.
assistant_forget_related: Also forget memories from this conversation
assistant_unsaved: Discard your message or unsaved changes?
assistant_busy: Wait for the operation to finish or stop the response before continuing.
assistant_sync_failed: Your change was saved. Your preferences could not be refreshed on this page.
assistant_snippet_disabled: This app is disabled. Your data is preserved.
assistant_snippet_unknown: This preview is unavailable in this version.
assistant_memory_description: Your assistant remembers what you share to help you better. Review, correct or forget these details at any time.
assistant_memory_separate: Memory is separate from history. Forgetting a memory does not delete conversation messages.
assistant_memory_confirm_all: Forget all memories? Conversation history will be preserved.
assistant_recovering: Response in progress. Syncing with the server…
assistant_sources_limits_unavailable: File limits are unavailable. Try again.
assistant_sources_max: You can attach up to {{count}} sources per message.
assistant_sources_type: This file format is not supported.
assistant_sources_size: This file exceeds the size limit, or the combined sources are too large.
assistant_source_delete_confirm: Permanently delete the contents of “{{name}}”? The reference will remain in the history.
assistant_url_help: The public page will be read and attached to your next message. Pages requiring sign-in are not accessible.
assistant_dictation_unsupported: Dictation is unavailable in this browser. You can use your keyboard’s dictation feature.
assistant_dictation_waiting: Allow microphone access in your browser.
assistant_dictation_permission: Microphone access was denied. Allow it in your browser settings.
assistant_dictation_device: The microphone or recording is unavailable. Check your device and try again.
assistant_dictation_size: Dictation exceeds the 10 MiB limit. Try a shorter recording.
assistant_dictation_empty: No speech was recognized. Try speaking clearly again.
assistant_dictation_overflow_help: Adding this transcript would exceed the message limit of 12,000 characters. Copy it below before closing. Your draft has been preserved.
assistant_dictation_settings_help: Dictation converts up to two minutes of audio into editable text. Audio is sent to the transcription provider and then discarded, without being stored in history.
assistant_dictation_use_chat: Use the conversation provider and API key
assistant_dictation_chat_help: Works with OpenAI and Google Gemini. For Anthropic, configure a separate transcription key.
assistant_dictation_unconfigured: Configure a compatible provider to use dictation.
